name: eBay Motors
description: eBay Motors is an automotive marketplace for vehicles, parts, and accessories. Buyers use it to search and compare vehicle listings, research seller and listing details, find parts by year, make, model, trim, and engine, and check compatibility; sellers and dealers use it to list automotive inventory.
agentUseSummary: eBay Motors is visible as a Buy API partner-review preview only. Relay will not collect an eBay username, password, passkey, one-time code, browser session, buyer payment detail, seller credential, developer keyset, client secret, OAuth token, or other credential, and no agent action is callable until eBay approves Relay's exact production business model, keyset, contracts, and bounded Motors Browse API use case.

capabilities.label: Read approved eBay Motors listings and compatibility
capabilities.description: After eBay approves Relay, search one bounded page of eligible Motors vehicle, parts, and accessory listings, read one exact listing's reduced decision fields, and check explicitly supplied car, truck, or motorcycle compatibility for supported parts.

blocked.label: Connect before Buy API approval
blocked.description: eBay production Buy API access is intended for approved partners and requires developer and partner onboarding, an accepted business model, contracts where applicable, a production keyset, and eBay enablement. Relay has none of that approval for this exact Motors use case.

blocked.label: Collect customer, seller, or developer credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not ask for an eBay username, password, passkey, one-time code, browser session, buyer payment detail, seller credential, developer keyset, client secret, OAuth token, or other secret as a substitute for eBay's approved application and authorization flow.

blocked.label: Run eBay Motors API actions
blocked.description: No listing search, item detail, compatibility, buying, bidding, offer, checkout, selling, inventory, messaging, identity, payment, or other eBay API action can run while Buy API partner and production review is pending.

blocked.label: Transactional and seller actions unavailable
blocked.description: Checkout, bidding, offers, purchases, payments, selling, listing or inventory changes, messaging or seller contact, account maintenance, and every other transaction or mutation remain outside Relay's planned read-only V1 even after approval.

approvalProfiles.label: eBay Buy API partner review pending
approvalProfiles.description: Motors Browse API actions remain unavailable until eBay approves Relay's exact business model, production keyset, contracts, marketplaces, categories, fields, limits, and read-only use case.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable until eBay approves Relay's production Buy API and Motors use case and Relay implements the approved read-only Railway broker.
No Hermes tools are callable until eBay approves Relay's production Buy API and Motors use case and Relay implements the approved read-only Railway broker.

providerSetup.blocker: eBay documents production Buy API access as a partner program rather than an automatically available public integration. A developer account, eBay Partner Network participation, an application describing the business model, support review, contracts where applicable, production enablement, a production keyset, and an Application Growth Check are required, with no guarantee of approval. Relay has no approved business model, contracts, production keyset, enabled Buy API access, accepted Motors marketplaces or categories, permitted data-field and affiliate-attribution contract, approved rate limits, or production acceptance for this use case.
providerSetup.nextAction: Authorized Relay business, product, legal, privacy, and security owners must apply for eBay Developer and Partner Network access, submit the exact bounded Motors listing-search, item-detail, and compatibility user flows and data flows, obtain all required contracts, a production keyset, Application Growth Check approval, and explicit production enablement. They must document approved marketplaces and categories, reduced response fields, affiliate attribution, query and result bounds, rate limits, retention, deletion, disconnect, audit, security, and incident duties. Engineering can then implement a fixed-origin Railway broker with only bounded listing search, one exact listing detail, and explicit vehicle or part compatibility reads. Checkout, bidding, offers, buying, selling, messaging, payments, identity data, automatic pagination, raw API delegation, and every mutation remain excluded.

evidence.supports: eBay says production Buy API access is intended for partners and requires developer and Partner Network accounts, a business-model application, eBay review, contracts where applicable, and production enablement, with no guarantee of approval.
eBay's buying-application guide requires a developer account and sandbox testing, then an Application Growth Check and production access; bidding through the Offer API requires additional approval.
The Browse API documents keyword, category, and item-aspect search, exact item details, and compatibility checks; supported compatibility products include cars, trucks, and motorcycles.
eBay describes Motors shopping for vehicles and parts, including searches by year, make, model, trim, and engine plus compatibility information and transactional buying options.
eBay describes the Motors product as supporting vehicle buying and selling, parts and accessories shopping, My Garage, and Fitment Finder.
